snippet.title: Timber Rush Trailer - Incremental Roguelite #gaming #indiegame
snippet.description:
This is Timber Rush an incremental roguelite game where you chop a tree buy upgrades and watch the logs chaotically fly around.  Try out the demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4298880/Timber_Rush/

Any and all feedback would be appreciated, and if you enjoyed it don't forget to wish list it!
#gamedev #incrementalgame #roguelite #unity #games #lumbertycoon2
